title: Give docs-only review stages a zero-server UI render-proof path
goal: PROBLEM: Verification guidance points reviewers at the headless screenshot tool (npm run capture:screenshot), but docs-only review stages must not spawn servers and port 3100 is unserved inside runner worktrees, so captures come back blank and every review of UI work either ships a pixel-evidence gap or wastes effort hand-building a one-off render harness. CASE STUDY: KainBain task 1cae113f-43ab-4613-801b-2de6297637fd (Surface runner git/commit and pre-commit hook failures clearly in the UI) hit this in three separate review stages: the first review shipped an explicit no-screenshot evidence gap after capture found nothing served, the second skipped pixels as proving the wrong thing, and the third hand-built a file:// SSR harness around the real component plus the production CSS bundle to get one honest screenshot. FIX (pick the smallest robust option): ship a reusable zero-server fixture renderer that turns a real component plus the production CSS into pixels with no app server; or make capture fail loudly on unserved/blank targets instead of writing blank PNGs; or codify in the review guidance that passing render tests count as proof for docs-only stages so agents stop retrying captures. ACCEPTANCE: (1) a docs-only review can produce pixel proof of a UI component without starting any server; (2) capture against an unserved target errors instead of emitting a blank image; (3) the guidance states which proof counts for docs-only stages.
